player_prompt.intro:
Woyɛ Player {player_id} a wɔreko Checkers sɛ {color}.
Yɛ wo nua wɔ chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Mmarae:
  • Fa mu kɔ anim wɔ diagonal so sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ.
  • Fa bɔɔlɔ no firi ase sɛ wɔbɛtumi aka wo.
  • Bɔɔlɔ no bɛyɛ King sɛ ɛkɔpem akyirikyiri.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Esiane sɛ wɔpɛ format bɔne. Fa [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Red nni nnwetɛbona biara bio. Black di nkonim!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Abibifo nni nnwetɛbona biara bio. Kɔkɔɔ di nkonim!
outcome.draw: Wɔadu baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛdan no.
